about.name: Sanjay Karunamoorthy
about.bio: University of Virginia graduate with a B.S. in Computer Science and a minor in Data Science. Builds reliable software, data-intensive systems, and practical AI applications.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Minor in Data Science

projects.name: Common
description: Engineered a geospatial discovery engine using geohash indexing, adaptive neighbor expansion, and Haversine filtering, ranking up to 500 simulated candidates per request at under 100 ms p95 latency across 1,000-profile Firestore benchmarks.
Eliminated an N+1 Firestore query pattern using transactionally maintained unread-count aggregates, reducing Inbox document reads by 80% and benchmarked query time from 139 ms to 7 ms.

projects.name: Curiosity
description: Improved discovery content retrieval through lightweight feed projections and lazy-loaded detail endpoints, consolidating up to 37 API requests into a single request per page load.
Designed a Supabase/PostgreSQL-backed knowledge graph to model concept relationships and learning progress, supporting personalized discovery through graph traversal and semantic embeddings.

projects.name: Moving Out
description: Research paper for a Toyota Research Institute-sponsored project.
Benchmarked MAPPO agents across 12 physics-based maps using BenchMARL, evaluating performance across four collaboration metrics.
projects.stack: Python, BenchMARL, MAPPO, Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

details: Reduced event-processing latency in a production ETL pipeline by 38% by migrating XML payload splitting from ECS/AWS Batch to AWS Lambda, eliminating approximately 60 seconds of startup overhead and enabling parallel execution.

Developing Python- and SQL-based data reconciliation and exception-handling logic for an AWS Aurora-backed loan-processing pipeline, validating record completeness across downstream services and detecting partial data loss.

Led a team of interns to develop a phase-gated PDLC system that streamlined project intake with LLM-drafted PRDs and risk scores, projected to save $158K annually, deployed to AKS using Terraform and Azure Pipelines CI/CD.

Architected a Redis cache-aside layer that reduced search latency by 88% (approximately 500 ms to under 60 ms), identifying bottlenecks with Prometheus; cut product-creation latency by 23% by decoupling Azure DevOps ticket creation via RabbitMQ.
Delivered a GraphQL and pandas automation pipeline to analyze DORA metric data across 17,000+ repositories, identify 2,000+ system owners, and automate targeted email notifications.

Improved Spring Batch processing runtime by 6% for a 3M search-data pipeline handling over 2 million records by eliminating redundant transformations in a Kafka/Airflow workflow, enabling faster streaming data.

Integrated the Claude API into a RAG pipeline powered by AWS Bedrock Titan embeddings and OpenSearch kNN retrieval, engineering prompts and API payloads to enable context-grounded response generation.
